propositions: The override table _MODEL_ID_CAPABILITY_OVERRIDES lists only us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-7 but rebar's DEFAULT_MODEL is claude-opus-4-8, leaving it unguarded against temperature rejection.

Both us.* and global.* Bedrock prefixes reject temperature on the opus-4-8 and opus-4-7 lines, but the table keys on full model IDs, so global.* variants are unguarded even if us.* variants are listed.
Temperature rejection is selective: temp=1.0 (API default) succeeds on opus-4-8 while temp=0.0 and temp=0.5 fail, indicating deprecated parameter tunability rather than total unsupport.

The Anthropic direct path (anthropic:claude-opus-4-8) silently drops temperature via pydantic-ai's _drop_unsupported_sampling_settings, while the Bedrock path hard-fails with 400, causing production nondeterminism in code-review Pass-2 which pins temperature=0 for determinism.
The top_p parameter is also deprecated on opus-4-8 and opus-4-7, but rebar's capability record lacks supports_top_p, creating a latent defect when any pass sets top_p.
